name: Jaffna

routes.outcome: Official Sri Lanka Survey Department SLCadastre viewer discovered. Browser-indexed HTML initially returned a WAF 406 to curl without a browser user-agent; a normal Mozilla user-agent GET returned the current JavaScript/configuration. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
Viewer-configured ArcGIS MapServer responded anonymously. It exposes polygon layer 0 Land_Use.

Layer schema returned geometryType esriGeometryPolygon, source CRS EPSG:5235, and native fields including pcl_pg_id2 (alias Parcel_ID2). The layer also contains claimant/name, land-name, remarks, and other fields; those unsafe or unnecessary fields were not requested or retained.
Exact WUP point query returned zero features. This is recorded only as an exact-point result, not as evidence of citywide absence; the point was not shifted.

Bounded anonymous Jaffna-area envelope query returned three polygon features with stable native Parcel_ID2 values and full geometry. The unchanged safe geometries are retained in jaffna-parcel-sample.geojson; only canonical id is retained in feature properties.

Official Registrar General's Department JSON office list identifies Jaffna Land Registry, Jaffna district, at District Secretariat Office Complex, Jaffna. This establishes a local registry custodian, not a claim that all parcels are title-registered.
Official RGD title-registration page states that title registration incorporates a cadastral map and lists Jaffna among implementing offices.
Official Tamil RGD page describes the unique title number and cadastral map containing location, boundaries, and extent.
Official Tamil Land Commissioner General's Department FAQ describes official survey measurement, boundary markers, and obtaining a land survey plan; it is procedure context, not a parcel API.

viewerInspection.crs: EPSG:5235 (native); retained sample was requested as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON coordinates

officialSources.observation: Survey Department SLCadastre public viewer JavaScript points to LUSE_Cadastre_2026 MapServer and queries parcel ID pcl_pg_id2.
RGD first-party office JSON lists Jaffna Land Registry in Jaffna district.
RGD explains cadastral-map/title workflow and lists Jaffna as an implementing office.
Official Tamil procedural source describing land survey plans and boundary marking.

unsafeFieldsNotRequestedOrRetained: and all other owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account fields
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [9.69888051612214, 80.0201144842049] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact-point zero result is not evidence of citywide absence; the bounded envelope proved nearby public geometry exists.
The retained sample is limited to three full polygons and contains exactly one canonical native identity in each feature's properties.
The public viewer's parcel-info api.php route was not called because the viewer passes land-name/use/extent fields and could expose unsafe details; only the safe ArcGIS ID+geometry route was used.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission; runtime remains held pending serial review.
remainingUncertainty: The exact-point parcel absence, complete city boundary coverage, field semantics beyond the safe ID, and whether every Jaffna parcel is represented in the current layer remain unresolved.
